title: Modernization Bridge
summary: Design a new PostgreSQL 16 service that reads accurate subsets from a legacy database through postgres_fdw, writes local truth safely, and plans migration without pretending a rewrite already has buy-in.
critical_queries: Resolve a local customer to the legacy customer row.
Read a legacy order list through FDW for one mapped customer.
Join local entitlements to a legacy product.
Refresh and read a materialized aggregate cache.
Find local writes waiting on legacy identity mapping.
Audit RLS tenant isolation on new-service rows.
Explain a foreign query and identify pushdown risks.

security_posture.tenant_isolation: RLS on all new-service tenant-owned tables even though legacy tables are not tenant-isolated
security_posture.extensions: postgres_fdw now; logical replication and Citus explicitly deferred

operational_notes: The design must keep legacy reads accurate, local writes correct, cache staleness named, FDW failure modes visible, and the migration path incremental.
